en: \[VSCode] Added a Hooks dialog to the command menu for viewing hooks and adding, editing, or removing them in user, project, and local settings; managed, plugin, and session hooks stay read-only
zh: \[VSCode] 在命令菜单中新增 Hooks 对话框，用于查看 hooks，并在用户、项目和本地设置中添加、编辑或删除 hooks；托管、plugin 和 session 的 hooks 保持只读
